title: DaVinci Resolve: Level One Edit & Advanced Techniques for Social Video (Mac & PC)

title: DaVinci Resolve Studio: 10 AI Tools Demonstrated with Timed Techniques
summary: This video showcases ten AI-enabled features directly built into DaVinci Resolve Studio, demonstrated in a practical editing workflow. Additional acceleration comes from AI-powered ripple delete for silences, a Smooth Cut transition to bridge gaps, and AI-driven speed warp for retiming video. The transcript anchors each section to exact DaVinci Resolve actions and settings, providing a concrete, timestamped map of the tools demonstrated.

title: Introduction to DaVinci Resolve: Media Management, Editing, Fusion, Color, and Fairlight (Comprehensive Beginner Course)
summary: This YouTube tutorial by Casey Faris presents a compact, hands-on tour of DaVinci Resolve geared to beginners, covering the full post-production workflow inside a single application. The video introduces Resolve’s modular pages (Media, Cut, Edit, Fusion, Color, Fairlight, Deliver), demonstrates essential media management (project libraries, metadata, bins, smart bins, and keyword tagging), walks through importing and organizing footage, and shows fundamental editing techniques (timeline assembly, trimming, in/out points, and anchor-style storytelling). It then moves into Fusion for node-based compositing, color grading with primary wheels, curves, and color management, advanced color-science concepts (log vs HDR wheels and scopes), and finally the Fairlight audio environment (multitrack mixing, buses, dynamics, EQ, and effects). A practical through-line runs from media management and timeline assembly to basic color correction, simple VFX (fog and masking) in Fusion, and basic audio design, concluding with deliverables and archiving. The course emphasizes practical, bite-sized steps and demonstrates how Resolve’s free version can cover 90% of users’ needs, while also noting the Studio edition’s extras (AI tools, more effects, and higher-end features).
